description: Day-by-day outbound charter flights to ONE Rainbow destination in a date window: per day the cheapest price and every flight with origin, departure time, airline, flight number, baggage and per-person/total price. Prices are charter seat prices in PLN. Get destination codes from rainbow_search_charters. Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, search_url, destination, period, days_with_flights, days: [...] } — the list key is `days`, one entry per calendar day: { date, cheapest_price, flights: [{ origin, destination, departure_time, price_per_person, total_price, currency, airline_code, flight_number, cabin_baggage_kg, checked_baggage_kg, meals_included }] }. A day with no flights is simply absent.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

origins.description: Polish origin IATA codes to filter by. Omit for all.
